**GENERAL EXPERIMENTAL**

The challenge involved evaluating the effect of oxidative stress and NAC-mediated cytoprotection across three cell culture models: 2D monolayers, 3D spheroids, and alginate hydrogels. The 2D and 3D models shared the same detection system (DCFH-DA) to allow for direct comparison, while the hydrogel model used resazurin as an indicator of metabolic viability. 

***Figure 1\.** General diagram of the experimental design, showing the workflow from cell culture to qualitative/semi-quantitative analysis for the three models evaluated: 2D monolayer, 3D spheroids, and alginate hydrogel.*

| GENERAL EXPERIMENTAL FLOW |
| ----- |
| Culture of HeLa cells in the exponential phase (70–80% confluence) |
| ↓ Seeding in the corresponding system (2D models / 3D spheroids / hydrogel) |
| ↓ Pretreatment with NAC (1 mM or 5 mM, 1 h) \+ PBS wash |
| ↓ H₂O₂ exposure by model: 100–250 μM for 4 h in 2D/spheroids; 400 μM overnight in hydrogel |
| ↓ Detection: DCFH-DA (microscopy) / Resazurin (plate reader) |
| ↓ Qualitative/semi-quantitative analysis of results |

***Note:** NAC treatment: 1 h pre-treatment in 2D/spheroids and rescue condition in hydrogel.*

## Alginate Hydrogel Model → 3D Encapsulation

Sodium alginate (1.5% w/v) was mixed with HeLa cells (1×10⁶ cells/mL) and ionically crosslinked using 100 mM CaCl₂ to form 3D hydrogels. After gelation, hydrogels were washed and incubated in complete DMEM at 37°C and 5% CO₂. Three conditions were evaluated: control, oxidative stress (400 μM H₂O₂), and antioxidant treatment (400 μM H₂O₂ \+ 5 mM NAC). Cellular metabolic activity was assessed using a resazurin assay, with samples incubated for 2–4 h before spectrophotometric analysis. The hydrogels maintained structural integrity and showed consistent dimensions throughout the experiment. 

# **Comparative Table of Methodological Parameters**

| Parameter | 2D Model | 3D Spheroids | 3D Hydrogel |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| **Culture system** | Standard 96-well plate | 96-well plate \+ 1% agar | 24-well plate |
| **Cell density** | 1×10⁴ cells/well | 5,000 cells/spheroid | 5×10⁵ cells/hydrogel |
| **Seeding volume / construct** | 100 μL complete DMEM | 20 μL complete DMEM | 0.5 mL alginate-cell mixture |
| **Maturation time** | 24 h (cell adhesion) | 48 h (spheroid formation) | 5 min gelation \+ 12–20 h |
| **H₂O₂ concentration** | 100, 150, 250 μM | 100, 150, 250 μM | 400 μM |
| **NAC concentration** | 1 and 5 mM | 1 and 5 mM | 5 mM |
| **NAC pretreatment** | 1 h \+ 2× PBS wash | 1 h \+ 2× PBS wash | Simultaneous (rescue) |
| **H₂O₂ exposure time** | 4 h | 4 h | Overnight (\~12 h) |
| **Probe / detection** | DCFH-DA, 10 μM | DCFH-DA, 10 μM | Resazurin, 44 μM/well |
| **Imaging / detection** | Brightfield \+ FITC | Brightfield \+ FITC | Plate reader (absorbance) |
| **Replicates** | n \= 3 wells/group | n \= 3 spheroids/group | n \= 1 (estimate) |
| **Analysis** | Semi-quantitative | Qualitative | Semi-quantitative |
